messages:
cassie: Heads up — premerge `sast/dast` job is failing with keystore decrypt errors on the PR pipeline. Started ~09:12 UTC. 403 from keystore service. Any recent RBAC changes?
rohin: Saw this too. We rolled a role-binding change for the realtime team last night; suspicious that the CI service account lost `keystore.decrypt`.
maya: Can you paste the error lines?
cassie: Logs: ```2026-03-22T09:11:58Z error keystore: access denied (403) caller=ci-runner@redwood-infra.svc account=ci-runner action=decrypt resource=projects/redwood-keystore/cryptoKeys/ci-provision```
security-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-042: Keystore decrypt failures in CI; linked audit logs and RBAC diff. https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-042
leo: Quick triage: most likely the binding change removed the `roles/keystore.decryptor` from the service account or the group it was in. Short-term workaround: grant scoped binding back or add the SA to `keystore-decrypters` group. Command: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-infra.svc --role=roles/keystore.decryptor` (use least-priv and expiry).
rohin: I'll run an ephemeral grant for the failing PRs and re-run the pipeline. After that we should revert to the intended RBAC state and open a follow-up to adjust the change. Leaving note in the runbook.
maya: We should also add a CI smoke test that attempts a dummy decrypt to catch regressions earlier. Proposed check: `ci/integration:keystore-smoke` that runs with a fixture key.
cassie: Runbook steps I propose:
1) Apply temporary binding with TTL (infra will do).
2) Re-run failing pipelines and confirm green.
3) Reconcile RBAC diff: determine whether change was too broad/narrow and PR a fix.
4) Add CI smoke test and an observability alert for repeated `keystore.decrypt` 403s.
leo: +1. Also add an entry to the ownership doc (OWNERS) for the keystore access reviewers so future RBAC flips have an approver.
rohin: Filing the postmortem note now and pinging @infra on the role diff. I'll attach the auditlog snippet showing the binding change.
maya: On it — I'll open the CI test PR and add the alert runbook snippet. Also we should update the security gating checklist to include keystore decrypt smoke tests for premerge.
infra-bot: Note: temporary binding applied by rohin until 2026-03-22T12:00:00Z. AuditID=ABCD-5098.
cassie: Thanks team — reopening the retrospective thread after we confirm the root cause. If anyone notices other services impacted, drop them here. :thumbsup:
